items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Leo was a great musician... I recall... he was part of the... symphony... I'm not sure he was ever with us in the, in the jazz band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. He, he was uh, he was part of the, he was in the, he was in the uh, the uh, the Colonel's favorite – the, the symphony, you know. So he played the jazz saxophone uh, when necessary in the symphony orchestra. So uh, when they had pieces that required that instrument, I recall. I'm not sure he was ever with us in the, in the jazz band. But uh, yeah, uh, Leo was a
great musician and as you know, he got discharged from the Army and joined Dizzy Gillespie. Had a nice, uh, career. Then he moved back to Germany and uh, started a family over there.
